properties.description: Mapping Data Flow for MCF Tarjetas extraction. Maps DataStage: EDWOS_TRANSBK_MCF output Lnk_MCF_Tarjetas -> Trf_MCF_T -> Trf_MCF_T_Final -> Trf_MCF_Tarjetas -> Seq_MCF_T(sink) + FL_Tarjetas(MCF_Card_Id_Tmp) + FL_Card_ANum(MCF_Card_Acct_Num_Tmp). Also: Hsh_Card_Dic, Hsh_Card_ANum, Hsh_Card_ANum2 lookups.

sources.name: SourceTarjetas
sources.description: IBM MCF Tarjetas fixed-width file. Maps to EDWOS_TRANSBK_MCF Lnk_MCF_Tarjetas.

sources.name: LookupCardDic
sources.description: Card dictionary lookup (Hsh_Card_Dic). Maps Lnk_de_Tab from LDM.

sinks.name: SinkTarjetasFinal
sinks.description: Write filtered Tarjetas to EDWOS.TRANSBK.MCF.TARJETA.TXT.FINAL. Maps to Seq_MCF_T CSeqFileStage.

sinks.name: SinkMCFCardIdTmp
sinks.description: FastLoad MCF_Card_Id_Tmp. Maps to FL_Tarjetas TeradataConnector.

sinks.name: SinkMCFCardAcctNumTmp
sinks.description: FastLoad MCF_Card_Acct_Num_Tmp. Maps to FL_Card_ANum TeradataConnector.

transformations.name: ParseTarjetasFixed
transformations.description: Parse COBOL fixed-width Tarjetas fields. Fields: TMC_TIPO_REG2, TMC_ACCT, TMC_CARD_ID, TMC_LOGO... MANUAL: Implement per COBOL copybook EDWOS_TRANSBK_MCF_T.

transformations.name: Trf_MCF_T
transformations.description: Initial Tarjetas split. TMC_TIPO_REG2='02' filter. Splits valid Tarjetas from eliminados.

transformations.name: LookupCardDicJoin
transformations.description: Card dictionary hash lookup (Hsh_Card_Dic). Keyed on TMC_CARD_ID.
